row: Animal Healing NOW with Dr. Michael Savko

Board certified doctor of chiropractic & certified in the incredible VOM healing techniques for large and small animals. Dr. Savko is not a veterinarian, nor does he practice veterinary medicine.  Since 2002 he has consulted with veterinarians to help enhance the quality of care for large and small animals. The doctor is also Reiki attuned, holds multiple certifications as a ThetaHealer®, and has experience with many heralded body and energy modalities such as massage, myofascial release, chakra balancing, acupressure, and other holistic and intuitive approaches to healing. 
​
This work can be thought of as a subtle yet very deep removal of stress to the commanding and stabilizing systems of the body in order to improve and maintain health.  Nerve and neuromuscular energetic points are evaluated and if imbalance is found, these points are stimulated to restore proper communication between the brain and body thus inducing healing!
